P.name: Soul Eater
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Nasus''' gains {{as|{{sti|life steal|{{pp|key=%|10 to 20 for 3|1 to 13}} life steal}}}}.

Q.name: Siphoning Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. ''Siphoning Strike's'' flat '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% of ''Siphoning Strike'' stacks)|buzzword}}}}
Q.description2: If ''Siphoning Strike'' kills the target, '''Nasus''' permanently gains {{as|4 stacks|buzzword}}, increased to {{as|10|buzzword}} if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|minion}}, or large {{tip|monster}}.
Q.description3: ''Siphoning Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nasus'''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Wither
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' ages the target enemy champion for 5 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 35% and {{tip|cripple|crippling}} them by{{ft|75% of that amount,|{{ap|35*0.75}}%,}}both increasing every second over the duration.
W.leveling:
{{st|Maximum Slow|{{ap|35+3*4 to 35+15*4}}%|Additional Slow Per Second|{{ap|3 to 15}}%}}
{{st|Maximum Cripple|{{ap|(35+3*4)*0.75 to (35+15*4)*0.75}}%|Additional Cripple Per Second|{{ap|3*0.75 to 15*0.75}}%}}

E.name: Spirit Fire
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' unleashes a spirit fire at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|centered at the location}} for {{tt|{{fd|2.5}} seconds|Estimated}} and, after a {{rutngt|0.25}} delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within.
E.description2: The fire then remains for 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} each second to enemies within and inflicting them with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}}, lingering for 1 second.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|10 to 34}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*10 to 34*10}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|30 to 50}}% of target's armor}}}}

R.name: Fury of the Sands
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, increased [[size]], and {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' attack range}} for the duration.
R.description2: While '''Nasus''' is empowered, he deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds to nearby enemies, capped at 240 per second, and ''{{ais|Siphoning Strike|Nasus}}'' {{sti|cooldown}} is halved.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{as|{{ap|1.5 to 2.5}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Total Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|1.5*30 to 2.5*30}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5*30}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
